items.title: Cross-repository contract drift
items.description: Capability and suite packets may independently restate shared contracts and drift from the versioned family authority.
items.impact: Incompatible discovery, planning, permission, provenance, completion, or result-reference behavior.
items.mitigation: Pin family packet provenance, keep shared surfaces narrow, validate references, and use the three-capability conventions checkpoint before extraction.

items.title: Packet reconciliation and source freeze
items.description: Final harness integrity and publication depend on completion of concurrent packet reconciliation and a stable source tree.
items.impact: Refreshing early would immediately create stale or misleading integrity evidence.
items.resolution_condition: Packet editing is complete, the packet read-only check passes, and all source owners confirm freeze.

items.title: Portable packet-validator runtime
items.description: The packet validator requires PyYAML and jsonschema, which are present only in a recorded host-specific Python runtime during adoption.
items.impact: A clean or different host may not run the documented packet check without separately authorized environment preparation.
items.resolution_condition: Document and validate an authorized portable dependency strategy in a later task or remove the third-party runtime requirement.
